items.title: Phil Mead interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, June 1, 2006
items.q: I love the big band, you know, Woody Herman and Stan Kenton.

ctx.x: Which is fascinating. Because I listen to a lot of hard bop, I listen to a lot of Dixieland, a lot of swing, a lot of thirties and forties stuff now and I’m even getting back into New Orleans stuff. There’s all that stuff on, and I love the big band, you know, Woody Herman and Stan Kenton. But they actually like Ellington, which I think is good.
